source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of phenols and making phenol (PDF 95).

blocks.text: Woh compounds jin mein hydroxyl group aromatic ring (arene) se jura ho phenols hain. Sab se saada khud phenol, C6H5OH, hai, jise carbolic acid bhi kehte hain, jo kabhi carbolic sabun mein use hota tha; yeh safaid qalmi thos hai. Doosri misalein 1-naphthol aur 2-naphthol hain, jin mein -OH group naphthalene par hai.

blocks.alt: Teen banawatein: phenol, OH wala benzene ring; 2-naphthol, do jure rings, position 2 par OH; 1-naphthol, do jure rings, position 1 par OH.
blocks.caption: Phenols ki misalein: phenol, 2-naphthol aur 1-naphthol (kitab ke PDF safha 95 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Phenol phenylamine aur nitrous acid (HNO2) se teen qadmon mein banaya ja sakta hai:

items: Nitrous acid rakhne ke liye bohat na-mustahkam hai, is liye test tube mein sodium nitrite (NaNO2) aur halke hydrochloric acid se banaya jata, barf se 10 C se neeche rakh kar.
Phenylamine nitrous acid se react kar ke na-mustahkam diazonium namak, benzenediazonium chloride, C6H5N2+ Cl-, banata hai.
Garam karne par diazonium namak paani se hydrolyse (tootta) hota, phenol aur nitrogen gas bante hain: C6H5N2+ Cl- + H2O -> C6H5OH + N2 + HCl.

blocks.alt: Phenylamine (NH2 wala benzene ring), teer ke oopar NaNO2 aur neeche 'HCl, < 10 degree C', se benzenediazonium chloride (ring par N+ teen bond N aur Cl-), jo teer ke oopar NaOH ke saath phenol + NaCl + N2 deta hai.
blocks.caption: Phenylamine se phenol ki tayyari (kitab ke PDF safha 95 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle qadam mein NaNO2 aur HCl test tube mein nitrous acid banate hain, aur 10 degree C se neeche phenylamine se benzenediazonium chloride banta hai. Is chapter (22.5) mein kitab aakhri qadam ke teer par NaOH likh kar phenol + NaCl + N2 deti hai, aur khaaka isi tarah bana hai. Chapter 24 mein kitab yahi qadam paani ke saath garam karna (H2O, heat) likhti hai, jis se phenol + N2 + HCl bante hain; aam tareeqa yahi garam paani wala hai. Dono jagah diazonium namak toot kar N2 gas chhorta hai aur ring par -OH aa jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Diazonium namak 10 C se neeche kyun banaya jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh na-mustahkam hai; is darje se oopar yeh istemal se pehle hi nitrogen kho kar toot jata hai (aur nitrous acid khud bhi toot'ta hai).

items: Phenylamine + HNO2 (NaNO2 + HCl, 10 C se neeche) -> diazonium namak; paani ke saath garam -> phenol + N2.
